learning.warningExternalContent: Created from a conversation containing external content (tool results) — review the proposed skill body especially carefully.
learning.riskUnreadableSkillFile: unreadable skill file (could not be scanned)
learning.verifyThinBody: the body is very short — too thin to be a reusable procedure
learning.verifyNoSteps: no numbered or bulleted steps — a skill should be a procedure (method), not declarative facts; leave facts to memory
learning.verifyDanglingEnding: the body appears to end mid-sentence — finish the last step
learning.verifyPlaceholder: TODO/TBD placeholders remain — fill them in with real values and steps
learning.verifyUnknownTool: the body instructs calling tool `{{param}}`, which is not in the current catalog — it may be a typo or a nonexistent tool
learning.verifyNoDescription: the description is missing or too short — the skill cannot be discovered in the index and is effectively dead
learning.verifyNearDuplicate: the name is similar to the existing skill '{{param}}' — consider patching that skill instead of creating a new one
learning.verifyPatchShrink: this patch deletes {{param}}% of the existing body — confirm the reduction is intentional
learning.candidateAwaitingEval: Approved — held until it beats the current version without regressions.
